items.claim: Navajo Sterling has fought good strikers but not great strikers.
items.quote: He's fought good strikers, not great strikers.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling will have the advantage at range against Jan Błachowicz.
items.quote: Navajo Sterling is going to be the one with the advantage at range.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling is much faster than Jan Błachowicz.
items.quote: Navajo Sterling's much faster than Jan Błachowicz.

items.claim: Jan Błachowicz relies on high blocks with his forearms to defend strikes.
items.quote: He gets those high blocks going in those big arm wrestler forearms of his.

items.quote: he does have the jiu-jitsu black belt.
